title: This Crab's Claw Is Stronger Than a Black Bear's Bite
subject: coconut crab

scenes.text: This crab's claw is stronger than a black bear's bite.
It is the coconut crab, the largest land crustacean, up to about three feet across.
Researchers measured 29 wild crabs. The biggest pinched with about 3,300 newtons.
A human bite is about 750 newtons. A wolf's is 1,270. A black bear's is 1,750.
Among land predators, the authors estimate only the alligator clamps harder.
The bigger the crab, the harder it pinches, and it can lift over 60 pounds.
